question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Remorse
solution:
The correct answer is option 1), i.e., 'Repentance.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given word:

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 Remorse
 a deep feeling of regret or guilt for doing something wrong or hurtful. (पछतावा, ग्लानि)
 
 
 

 
 

 
 
• 
 
​Let's look at the meanings of the other given options:

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 Repentance
 the fact of showing that you are very sorry for something bad you have done in the past, and wish that you had not done it. (पछतावा, ग्लानि, सोच)
 
 

 Slow
 taking a long time to do something. (धीमा)
 
 

 Liberate
 to set free. (मुक्त करना, स्वतंत्र करना, रिहा करना)
 
 

 Affinity
 a natural liking or attraction to someone or something. (आत्मीयता, लगाव, मेल)
 
 
 
 

 

 
• Clearly, the word 'Repentance' is closest in meaning to the given word 'Remorse.'
 
• Therefore, the correct synonym of the given word is option 1.
